brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Hangs on wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: Two keyhole accessories installed on outside faces: accessory:0#0,0#1 (piece 0,0,0) and accessory:0#1,0#1 (piece 1,0,0) – slot 1 is the rear wall face of the 3-cell bar (-1,0,0; 0,0,0; 1,0,0) for screw heads in wall.
Three hex-acc-hook plates on front faces slot 4: accessory:0#-1,0#4, accessory:0#0,0#4, accessory:0#1,0#4 – each plate provides two hooks, total six hooks across rack for pliers, screwdrivers, etc.

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell horizontal rail (pieces -1,0,0 to 1,0,0). Rear side has two keyhole hangers; front side has three hook plates (six hooks). Open faces capped and joints locked.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.name: Hook plate
parts.use: Each plate carries two hooks side by side, so you bolt on as many as you want where you want them rather than committing a whole face to a rail.
